SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-09: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition - Key Elements: Where; ViewDefinition.where; ViewDefinition.where.path/description. Test these items: where 0..* root-level FHIRPath constraints; every where constraint must evaluate true for resource inclusion; false, empty, and null filter results exclude rows as specified; non-boolean where results are rejected or surfaced as spec errors; where.description 0..1 human-readable text retention; constant references and complex FHIRPath expressions inside where clauses; filter SQL generation preserves intended root-resource scope. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
